objective:
Satisfy Tasks 1, 2, and 7 by verifying the Venue entity class, creating ApiError and Express
        error-handling middleware, mounting the error handler in app.js, implementing VenueController.create, and
        registering POST /venues route.

decisions.decision:
Verify existing backend/src/entities/Venue.js without modification as it already fulfills all
          Task 1 requirements (generates UUID id and ISO createdAt, implements belongsTo(userId) boolean method, and toJSON
  serialization).

Create backend/src/errors/ApiError.js with an ApiError class extending Error that accepts
  (statusCode, message) or (message, statusCode), exposes statusCode and status properties, and provides static
  factory helpers (badRequest, forbidden, notFound, internal).

Create backend/src/middleware/errorHandler.js defining standard Express 4-argument error-
  handling middleware that extracts err.statusCode || err.status || 500 and err.message and responds with
  status(code).json({ error: message }).

Modify backend/src/app.js to replace the inline placeholder error handler with the imported
  errorHandler middleware from ./middleware/errorHandler.

Modify backend/src/routes/venueRoutes.js to register router.post('/', venueController.create),
  exposing POST /venues and POST /api/venues.

invariants: Do not modify AGENTS.md, .gitignore, or any file under .agents/**.

Preserve all existing GET /venues behaviors and pass existing tests in backend/tests/Venue.test.js and
  backend/tests/venues.routes.test.js.
Error responses must strictly output { error: message } with appropriate HTTP status codes (400, 403, 500).
Successful venue creation must return HTTP status 201 with toJSON() serialized entity payload.
Maintain Clean Architecture boundary and exception propagation conventions.

instructions: Verify that Venue constructor takes (name, description, location, ownerId) or props object.
Verify that id is generated internally via crypto.randomUUID() when not provided.
Verify that createdAt is generated internally as ISO string when not provided.
Verify that belongsTo(userId) returns boolean indicating whether venue belongs to userId.
Verify that toJSON() returns an object with { id, name, description, location, ownerId, createdAt }.
acceptance:
All tests in backend/tests/Venue.test.js pass without requiring alterations to
  backend/src/entities/Venue.js.

instructions: Create ApiError class extending Error.

Accept statusCode and message in constructor (supporting both (statusCode, message) and (message,
  statusCode)).
Set this.statusCode and this.status to the given HTTP status code (default 500).
Set this.name = 'ApiError'.

Provide static factory methods: badRequest(msg = 'Bad Request'), forbidden(msg = 'Forbidden'),
  notFound(msg = 'Not Found'), internal(msg = 'Internal Server Error').

Export ApiError both as default and named export (module.exports = ApiError; module.exports.ApiError =
  ApiError;).
acceptance:
const err = new ApiError(400, 'Invalid input'); expect(err instanceof Error).toBe(true); expect(err.
  statusCode).toBe(400); expect(err.message).toBe('Invalid input');

const err403 = ApiError.forbidden('Access denied'); expect(err403.statusCode).toBe(403); expect(err403.
  message).toBe('Access denied');

instructions: Create Express error-handling middleware function with signature (err, req, res, next).
Extract status code as err.statusCode || err.status || 500.
Extract message as err.message || 'Internal Server Error'.
Return res.status(status).json({ error: message }).

Export the function both as default and named export (module.exports = errorHandler; module.exports.
  errorHandler = errorHandler;).
acceptance:
Calling errorHandler with an ApiError(400, 'Bad Request') sends status 400 with body { error: 'Bad
  Request' }.

Calling errorHandler with a generic Error('Database error') sends status 500 with body { error:
  'Database error' }.

instructions: Import errorHandler from './middleware/errorHandler'.
Replace the inline error-handling middleware placeholder with app.use(errorHandler).
acceptance: backend/src/app.js uses the imported errorHandler middleware from ./middleware/errorHandler.

instructions: In VenueController constructor, bind create: this.create = this.create.bind(this);
Implement async create(req, res, next) method:
Extract data from req.body (and req.user / req.currentUser if present).
Call await this.venueService.registerVenue(req.body, req.user).
Serialize result using typeof venue?.toJSON === 'function' ? venue.toJSON() : venue.
Return res.status(201).json(venueJson).

In catch block: if typeof next === 'function', return next(error); otherwise return res.status(error.
  statusCode || error.status || 500).json({ error: error.message }).
acceptance:
Calling controller.create(req, res, next) with valid body calls venueService.registerVenue, returns 201,
  and outputs serialized venue JSON.

Calling controller.create(req, res, next) when venueService.registerVenue throws an ApiError passes
  error to next(error) or directly responds with proper status code and { error: message }.

instructions: Register POST route on router: router.post('/', venueController.create);
